title: Flame Blade
description: Adds the flame blade, recipes, and flame upgrade templates
body: **Ever wated to spice your game up? Well we got you, literally** This mod adds a new weapon; the flame blade! it is the most over-powered weapon- **EVER!** it also adds 2 recipes (crafting and smithing) and a new item- the Heat upgrader! (relies on fabric api 1.21.8, other mods like soidum or lithium can sometimes break it, all mods will break it if not a 1.21.8-11 fabric mod) THIS IS ARCHIVED, I AM FOCUSING FULLY ON A NEW MOD
